description: The pinned art pack (ADR 0002, docs/adr/0002-pinned-art-pack.md): which release of the Project art the game uses, where it is installed, and the import rules that depend on it. bash scripts/art_pack.sh fetch reads the release block; ArtPack (scripts/core/art/art_pack.gd) and ArtImport (scripts/core/art/art_import.gd) read the rest. Bump the pack by changing the release block and the checksum manifest together (CONTRIBUTING.md, Art pack releases).
reason: Project art is pinned as a Release asset, not generated in the repo (ADR 0002); spec #59, ticket #62.

project_art.made_by: Jarvis, the project owner's ChatGPT agent
project_art.made_with: Blender 4.3.2, procedurally (the generators stay with Jarvis; a not-run copy ships under reference/)
project_art.delivered: 2026-10-13, as nine ZIPs attached to #59 (pack v1), corrected by Jarvis's v1.1 patch (2026-10-14, #61)
project_art.packaged_by: tools/art_pack/build_release.py (PACKAGING.json in the asset records the source ZIP's SHA-256)

corrections.what: a focused correction overlay of 76 files (PATCH_MANIFEST.json, each with its before and after SHA-256): the lowercase environment/glb/bed.glb renamed bed_single.glb at the source (bytes unchanged; art-pack-v1.0 had renamed it in packaging), the inventory icons of 1439 Basic Archer Gloves, 1440 Brown Duo and 900 Amethyst Earrings recomposed as a compact pair, a stronger Wooden Box Hit (damped rotation and child-piece rattle), the tomato fruit moved out of the foliage in Tomato_Plant.glb and the ten plants of Veg_Garden_Bed.glb, and a taller Tutorial Jr. Sentinel (fitted top about 0.879 m under the width cap, inside its 0.9 m touch zone)
corrections.merged_into: the v1.0 nine-ZIP extraction (byte-identical to the ZIPs but for the lowercase bed.glb a case-insensitive file system cannot hold), patched with its checksum-checked installer; every after-hash matched. The merged folder was zipped as one delivery, MisoStory_Assets_v1.1_Merged_Source.zip (SHA-256 5cac18e1c489172479dd4cf8a4f1c0f6d514b26d1e34b06a5732c37a57002aaa), and packaged with build_release.py.
corrections.asset_index_changes: the bed's path and the checksums of the four changed models (Tomato_Plant, Veg_Garden_Bed, TutorialJrSentinel, WoodenBox), plus a correction_version key; no gameplay data

character_scale.factor_reason: One uniform factor fits the Beginner to the game's 1.5 m body (#59 decision 6): body_height_m / reference_height_m. Applied on import to the player presets, the 21 NPCs, the wearables and the hair and face modules, so relative heights stay as Jarvis made them. Monsters keep model_fit.
character_scale.reference_height_reason: Beginner_Male's bounds in the pack's godot_validation.json: y 0.0075 to 1.99 m, hair included.
